details: Current recovery creates explicit zero-credit causal UNKNOWN re-entry for interrupted or ambiguous legacy episodes; stale restart tests asserted zero causal rows.
Current recovery advances one global entity generation and returns generation plus additional recovery counters; stale restart tests asserted an older exact result dictionary.
Current recovery hashes receipts with compact JSON separators; stale restart test used default json.dumps separators.
Current legacy persisted-effect closure state is RECOVERED_LEGACY_EFFECT_REENTERED; stale restart test expected RECOVERED_EFFECT_REENTERED.
Current recovery counts every active_turn as scanned and appends one TURN_ABORTED recovery system turn; stale effect-replay regression expected scanned=0 and zero recovery abort turns.
Pending effects recovered to UNKNOWN_AFTER_RESTART are causally re-entered before the active turn is retired, after which the workspace closes as RECOVERY_CLOSED_AFTER_EFFECT_REENTRY.

delta.intent: Align directly coupled restart/effect-replay regression assertions with the already-current fail-closed recovery and global-generation contract without changing runtime semantics.

limitations: GitHub connector exposed repository text but not a filesystem mount into the isolated container.
The isolated container had no network route to clone the private repository.
The available Vercel connector exposed Sandbox documentation only, not sandbox start or exec.
The GitHub PR workflow failed before any visible step executed, so it establishes no pytest result.
Therefore no pytest, OCI build, startup, Clerk, PTY, Claude Code, restart-runtime, or whole-product PASS is claimed.

unusual_experiment.reason: No immutable request id was available and the supplied trigger timestamp had minute precision only; the current atomic lease protocol requires a canonical per-trigger identity before consuming the one unusual-experiment slot.
